state.generated_sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.orderDate) AS order_month,
        c.categoryName,
        SUM(od.unitPrice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS category_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderID = od.orderID
    JOIN products p ON od.productID = p.productID
    JOIN categories c ON p.categoryID = c.categoryID
    WHERE c.categoryName IN ('Beverages', 'Condiments')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
total_monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        order_month,
        SUM(category_revenue) AS total_monthly_all_selected
    FROM monthly_revenue
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    mr.order_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mr.categoryName = 'Beverages' THEN mr.category_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mr.categoryName = 'Condiments' THEN mr.category_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS condiment_revenue,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN mr.categoryName = 'Beverages' THEN mr.category_revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(tmr.total_monthly_all_selected, 0)) * 100 AS beverage_percentage_of_selected
FROM monthly_revenue mr
JOIN total_monthly_revenue tmr ON mr.order_month = tmr.order_month
GROUP BY 1, tmr.total_monthly_all_selected
ORDER BY 1 ASC
